chapter: New York, Henderson and Charlie Johnson
title: How long he stayed with Fletcher and what came between Henderson and Fats
summary: He sorts out that Henderson was only a few months, between gigs, and that he went back to Small's Paradise before Fats.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long did you stay with Fletcher this particular time?
Well I was with Fletcher -- now how
many months? Not too many months, because I did this between Fats and, you know, and I had to go back to Fats.
We haven't even gotten to Fats yet, though. This is when you first got to New York. Right? This was your first job when you --
So you must have done something else before Fats came along.
Yeah, because I went in to -- no, ah, you're right. I left him and went back to -- went back to Small's Paradise.
Well, had you been to Small's Paradise before?
When you first came to New York you got a place to live, and then you went over to Fletcher's house, the rehearsal. And you stayed with the band for --
That was a gig in here, a couple of gigs there, and I ran into this man from Washington whom I had been working under. He was --
You want to take a break a minute, Herman?
No, no. I want to get the Kleenex,
but I can't get over there. I'm going to turn it off just a minute. We'll pick it right back up.
